correlation of diesel prices with CPI food: the freight channel does not carry the food move.

sections.h2: Diesel fails the freight test: it correlates −0.16 with CPI food

chart.title: Diesel tracks the wholesale index, not the food prices on the shelf
chart.sub: Correlation (r) of diesel price growth with each index, FY2012–FY2026.
chart.source: This blog's August 2026 piece; DPIIT and MoSPI official data.

sections.means: Diesel price growth does not track food CPI, so a freight-cost shock is not the main driver of 2026 food prices.
sections.todo: Run the lag test over one to three months, the window in which freight costs would normally reach shop prices, before ruling out any pass-through.

sections.h2: Ethanol takes 29% of India's maize crop, the same grain poultry feed needs

chart.title: Distilleries take 29% of the maize crop, and maize is 55% of poultry feed
chart.sub: Share, %, of the 2024-25 maize crop and of poultry feed by weight.
chart.source: Lok Sabha written reply, 17 Dec 2025; trade-press feed estimates (BusinessToday, Outlook Business).
rows: Maize used for ethanol, share of 2024-25 crop
Maize share of poultry feed, by weight

sections.means: Distillers and poultry farmers bid for the same maize, so ethanol demand reaches the egg shelf through feed costs.
sections.todo: Quote only the 29% crop share and the 12.6 million tonnes figure, not the earlier 37% or 17 million tonne numbers.

sections.h2: Egg prices rose 35–40% year on year, more than the 15% rise in feed

chart.title: Egg prices rose far faster than poultry feed costs in 2026
chart.sub: Year-on-year change, %, as reported for mid-2026 and September 2026.
chart.source: NECC price data and trade-press reports (BusinessToday; Outlook Business); CLFMA review via AgroSpectrum.
rows: Poultry feed cost, July 2026 vs a year earlier
Egg retail price, Sept 2026 vs a year earlier

sections.means: The reported 35–40% egg rise is about twice the 15% feed rise, which fits feedstock competition but does not prove it alone.
sections.todo: Re-check the egg figure against the July ₹687 and August ₹546 per 100 prints, since the Sept 2026 figure is unconfirmed.
